BOOTSTRAP_READY.meaning: 编排与冻结接口可用；不宣称独立验收或联网完成

G1_LIVE.meaning: 指定网络/合约/块范围真实只读样本，不是收益验证

G2_LIVE.meaning: 按具体能力范围，不将未支持模块写成已验证

EXECUTION.meaning: 本包未提供/授予签名广播和资金动作

source_policy.code_digest_scope: selected reusable source + transitive dependencies + relevant configuration/build/tests
source_policy.code_change_action: M1/M4 targeted review; unaffected tasks and pinned code work may continue
source_policy.unknown_change_action: classify or quarantine only the affected input

bootstrap_dependency_policy: T01-T04 may progress on M1 BOOTSTRAP_PREPARED records; M4 T43 PASS required before G1 release, no circular bootstrap wait
bootstrap_downstream_policy: After BOOTSTRAP_READY, recorded T03/T04 preparation may feed isolated downstream development pending T43; failed source review invalidates affected candidates; no G1 release without T43 PASS
